title: `concepts/predictive-processing` carries five defects in its Relation to Site Perspective and falsifier list: L184 says PP "depends on outcomes being singular and definite—collapse being real" and that Many-Worlds renders "prediction error" meaningless; L178 has the Zeno mechanism "biasing indeterminate outcomes" against P-Q4 and the Stapp page; L182 calls conscious selection "a deeper-level instance of active inference"; L76/L176 present "makes no claims about subjective experience" as a PP-proponent concession of the explanatory gap that Hohwy & Seth (2020) do not make; L168's decoherence falsifier is unreachable under post-decoherence selection
